Generate Random Pairwise Comparison Ratings Vector

Source: R/simulations.R
randomPRR.Rd

Generates a random upper-triangular pairwise comparison ratings vector sampled from Saaty's 1/9 to 9 ratio scale (or a custom evaluation scale) for a Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix (PRM) of dimension n (Section 4; Yuen, 2024).

Usage

randomPRR(n = sample(3:15, 1), scale = c(1/(9:1), 2:9))

Arguments

n

Integer. Dimension of the Pairwise Reciprocal Matrix (PRM), representing the number of evaluation criteria. Defaults to a random integer sampled between 3 and 15.

scale

Numeric vector. Set of discrete rating scale values from which pairwise comparisons are sampled. Defaults to Saaty's standard AHP scale c(1/9, 1/8, ..., 1/2, 1, 2, ..., 9).

Value

A numeric vector of length n(n-1)/2 containing randomly sampled pairwise comparison ratings.

References

Yuen, K. K. F. (2024). Inverse Gram Matrix Methods for Prioritization in Analytic Hierarchy Process: Explainability of Weighted Least Squares Optimization Method. arXiv preprint arXiv:2401.01190. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2401.01190

Author

Kevin Kam Fung Yuen

Examples

# Generate a random ratings vector for a 4x4 matrix
ratings <- randomPRR(n = 4)
print(ratings)
#> [1] 5.00 4.00 0.20 0.25 7.00 7.00
